mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts and a low unemployment rate signal a growing economy with high consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods with high consumer confidence (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP growth rate signal an extremely accommodative monetary policy and a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during monetary easing cycles with high GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate above 6% signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is above 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong decrease in retail sales and a high unemployment rate signal a weak economy with low consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during recessions with low consumer confidence (t-test p > 0.05).
